# ASAPP Appoints Katie Stein as CEO to Accelerate AI Transformation of the Contact Center
## Veteran CX executive brings operational depth as company shifts from product transformation to scaling growth
**NEW YORK, August 4, 2026** – [ASAPP](https://www.asapp.com/), the [Customer Experience Platform](https://www.asapp.com/cxp) (CXP) powering AI-driven customer service for the agentic enterprise, today appointed Katie Stein as chief executive officer.
